bio.text: Michael Gates is the Republican candidate for California Attorney General in 2026.
He served as city attorney of Huntington Beach and, in 2025, as a deputy assistant U.S. attorney general at the Justice Department before launching his campaign in January 2026.
According to his candidate statement, he is a husband and father of five.
